The second command is the positive/negative control: vidore-benchmark's own built-in random-embedding retriever, run on the identical input, scores nDCG@5=0.19678 (recall@3=0.25), exit 0, 11.0s -- proving the real model's clean-looking score is not vacuous.
limitations: Ran on CPU (48 cores) because free GPU VRAM was below the required 10GB gate for the whole trial window; wall time is not representative of GPU throughput for this model family.

12-example local slice of the official test split (a full 280-row/70-image run of the same split was attempted but interrupted by our own 28-minute timeout after 6/18 needed image batches -- recorded, not hidden, in results-20260926.json).

The dataset-name path is a local directory built for this trial (a slice saved via datasets' own .to_parquet()); the upstream Hub dataset it slices is vidore/tabfquad_test_subsampled, and this local path will not persist beyond the scratch directory's lifetime.
